articles.title: The "space bomb" that fell on Canada. Why did the nuclear reactor satellite of the USSR crash?
articles.summary: On January 24, 1978, a bright fireball crossed the sky over the almost uninhabited northern regions of Canada. Then there is a loud explosion. At first, people think that a huge meteorite hit the earth. When the area is examined, radiation rays are detected in metal pieces found around. Then it becomes clear that a Soviet satellite equipped with a nuclear reactor crashed into Canada.
